title: kmeans_cluster depreciated message
description:
The package version of the kmeans_cluster() function generates a broken (notice **Please use**) depreciation message but the function shown in *R Markdown: The Definitive Guide* does not result in any message/warning.  

> bootstrapPage is deprecated. Please use The 'responsive' argument is no longer used with Bootstrap 3. instead. To disable this message, run options(shiny.deprecation.messages=FALSE)

# Steps to reproduce the problem
```
library(rmdexamples)
kmeans_cluster(iris)
```

title: datatable with ggvis
description:
Hi.

I tried use datatables with ggvis in the one document. My conlusion is only one of them can work in a same time.

You can reproduce it with following:

``````

---
title: "Untitled"
output: html_document

---

```{r include=FALSE}
library(rmdexamples)
library(htmltools)
library(ggvis)
library(knitr)
```

```{r}
datatable(cars)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
cars %>% ggvis(x = ~dist, y = ~speed) %>% layer_points()
```
``````

Any ideas?

~~
Artem

title: datatable.R not compatible with actual htmltools version
description:
Hi.

Seems `datatable.R` broken now. For example, now `htmltools` not include `html_escape` and `html_dependency` functions. It was renamed with `htmlEscape` and `htmlDependency`. `html_print` has only 1 argument etc.

``
wbr
Artem Klevtsov
